messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Alert: embeddings-p95-high triggered in production
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P13002 paged eng-oncall - inferred priority: page
jen: oncall here, pulling logs/dashboards now
arun: p95 spike started 09:12 UTC, peaks at ~1.2s (baseline 0.45s) across eu-central-1 embeddings service
carmen: seeing correlated CPU steal and long GC pauses on embeddings-worker-3 instances
ops-bot: infra notified, INF-800 created and assigned to infra-oncall
jen: mitigation plan: (1) cordon problematic workers, (2) scale up embeddings-workers pool by +3, (3) enable degraded routing to quantized-embed-small variant
arun: adding temporary route in the router: prefer embed-small for eu-central-1 traffic with weight 40%
carmen: note: errors didn't spike much, most requests succeeded but latency impacted user flows for search/autocomplete -> perceived slowness for enterprise customers
jen: customer impact estimate: <1% error, but p95 latency SLO for embeddings violated for ~12 minutes in eu-central-1, impacting ~8% of requests from that region
arun: request: do not treat short p95 blips as pages. We should page on latency only when either a) sustained for 10m or b) accompanied by error-rate > 1% or c) SLO-impact annotation > 0.2%
jen: agree. current prometheus rule is too eager: it pages on a single window. here's a proposed replacement:
```
- alert: EmbeddingsLatencyHigh
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"embeddings\"}[5m])) by (le, job)) > 0.7
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Embeddings p95 latency high"
    slo_impact: ":slo_estimate:calc():"
```
jen: and add a secondary, lower-severity alert for short spikes:
```
- alert: EmbeddingsLatencyTransient
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"embeddings\"}[1m])) by (le, job)) > 0.7
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "Transient p95 spike - investigate if recurring"
```
arun: also propose a composite alert expression that pages when slo_impact annotation > 0.2. we can calculate approximate SLO impact in the recording rule and attach it as an annotation: e.g. `slo_impact = (p95_current - p95_slo) * request_volume_fraction`
alert-manager: Draft routing policy (will add to infra repo) - mapping based on labels and annotations:
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match": {"severity": "page"}, "receiver": "pagerduty-eng-oncall"},
    {"match": {"severity": "ticket"}, "receiver": "#eng-sre"},
    {"match_re": {"slo_impact": ".*(0\.[2-9]|[1-9])"}, "receiver": "pagerduty-eng-oncall"}
  ],
  "group_wait": "30s",
  "group_interval": "5m",
  "repeat_interval": "2h"
}
```
carmen: important: add inhibition rules so recurring transient alerts don't flood PD. e.g., inhibit transient ticket if page exists for same alertname+service
jen: yes, also enable grouping by instance and region to avoid a page per-host for cascade failures
arun: follow-ups after stabilizing: (1) add p95-by-model dashboard panel, (2) a small synthetic to detect GC-caused latency (run quick heap-check probe), (3) recording rule that emits slo_impact estimate, (4) update runbook text around degraded routing and quantized fallbacks
jen: I'm going to open PRs: one for prometheus rules, one for alertmanager routing, one for the dashboards. tagging @sre and @platform for review
triage-bot: Postmortem skeleton created: PM-462 assigned to jen as incident lead; arun timeline owner
carmen: also recommend tuning autoscaler to react to queued depth instead of CPU for embeddings-workers to avoid GC-related thrashing next time
arun: agree, I'll prototype a queue-depth metric and autoscaler policy in staging
jen: oncall handoff: i'm handing to arun in 25m. i'll remain on slack for questions. thanks for quick help
arun: taking over. will follow through on PRs and autoscaler task. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P13002 status -> mitigated. keeping open for postmortem items
jen: scheduling postmortem 09:00 UTC tomorrow. please add logs, flamegraphs, gc metrics to the incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/p13002
ops-bot: Notifying customer success for any enterprise customers that saw degraded latency
jen: closing thread; recorded actions: update alerts, add grouping/inhibition, add slo_impact routing, autoscaler change prototype, dashboard panels
